source.product: Impact Observatory / Esri 10 m Annual Land Use Land Cover, 9-class

measure: area of each land cover class inside the unit, km2
method: ee.Image.pixelArea() summed per class through a grouped reducer, so ground area is correct whatever projection the reduction lands in. Deriving area from the scale would be wrong here: the collection mosaics UTM tiles, and a nominal 10 m pixel covers 100·cos(latitude) m2 in the geographic fallback.
